models_evaluated: Baseline plus Amazon Titan discharge-summary embeddings
unlisted_practices: Defining prediction labels faithfully to the CMS Hospital-Wide Readmission measure (unplanned readmissions only, planned-readmission algorithm, exclusions) instead of a naive 30-day label
Leakage-guarded feature specification for readmission prediction
Open, versioned release of cohort logic and code lists for reproducibility

screen.reason: The study develops and evaluates an open-source, standardized implementation of the CMS Hospital-Wide Readmission measure on MIMIC-IV to benchmark predictive models (including testing fairness, drift, and text embeddings). It does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
